s: December 20, 1996 - I would probably never watch this film, had it not been for my wife who rented the DVD. Like others here, I expect romantic comedies to be all the same - terribly unrealistic and the humor to be 3rd-grade. But One Fine Day surprised me in many ways! First, it is not "I need insulin right now!" sweet.
